All 5 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend Playwright tests confirmed filtering works correctly: All Teams shows 6 athletes, Men's Team shows 3 male athletes (Lucas Silva, Pedro Santos, Gabriel Costa), Women's Team shows 3 female athletes (Ana Oliveira, Julia Pereira, Maria Souza).
